items: (a) Using SST, remove the snap ring.

content.description: Illustration showing snap ring removal from rotor using special service tool (SST)

items: (b) Using a plastic hammer, tap the rotor off the shaft.

content.text: Be careful not to damage the pulley when tapping on the rotor.

content.description: Illustration showing rotor being tapped off shaft with plastic hammer

items: (a) Disconnect the stator lead wires from the compressor housing.

content.description: Illustration showing stator with lead wires being disconnected from compressor housing

items: (b) Using SST, remove the snap ring. Remove the stator.

content.description: Illustration showing snap ring removal from stator using special service tool (SST)

content.text: Press the bearings out only if they are to be replaced.

items: (a) Remove the bearing snap ring from the rotor.
(b) Using SST, press out the two bearings.

content.description: Technical diagram showing bearing removal process using special service tool (SST) with press operation
